en: Opt-in native HTTP client module imported with `import http from "http";`.
HttpRequestOptions supports headers, body, contentType, and a positive integer timeout in milliseconds.

HttpResponse contains status, statusText, ok, url, lowercase headers, body, text, and bytes. HTTP error status codes are normal responses; only transport, timeout, and response-reading failures become errors.
Responses are fully buffered. Redirects and common decompression are automatic, and cookies are not retained.
zh-CN: 通过 `import http from "http";` 导入的可选原生 HTTP 客户端模块。
HttpRequestOptions 支持 headers、body、contentType，以及以毫秒为单位的正整数 timeout。
HttpResponse 包含 status、statusText、ok、url、小写键 headers、body、text 和 bytes。HTTP 错误状态码仍是正常响应；仅传输、超时和响应读取失败进入错误流程。
响应会被完整缓冲；自动处理重定向和常见解压，且不会保留 Cookie。

overloads: replace(script: string, ignoreDepends?: boolean)
replace(modulePath: string, script: string, ignoreDepends?: boolean)

en: Replaces a module using the supplied script source.
Passing only script patches the current module.
Relative modulePath values resolve from the current module Source.FullPath directory.

The resolved full path selects the target; @module name does not. A patch cannot rename a loaded module, while omitting @module preserves its existing explicit name. A new path creates a new named or anonymous module.
zh-CN: 使用提供的脚本源码替换模块。
只传 script 时会修补当前模块。
相对 modulePath 会从当前模块 Source.FullPath 所在目录解析。
解析后的完整路径用于选择目标，@module 名称不参与定位。补丁不能重命名已加载模块；省略 @module 时会保留已有显式名称。新路径会创建新的命名或匿名模块。

overloads: incremental(script: string, ignoreDepends?: boolean)
incremental(modulePath: string, script: string, ignoreDepends?: boolean)

en: Applies an incremental module hot patch.
Passing only script patches the current module.
Relative modulePath values resolve from the current module Source.FullPath directory.

The resolved full path selects the target; @module name does not. A patch cannot rename a loaded module, while omitting @module preserves its existing explicit name. A new path creates a new named or anonymous module.
zh-CN: 应用增量模块热更新。
只传 script 时会修补当前模块。
相对 modulePath 会从当前模块 Source.FullPath 所在目录解析。

zh-CN: 运行时热更新 API，用于替换或增量更新模块。

en: Compiler-provided global execution object for the current script domain.
zh-CN: 编译器提供的当前脚本域全局执行对象。

en: Returns a module loaded in the current script domain by its explicit @module name, or null when no explicitly named module matches.
This is a name lookup only: it does not import a source, does not derive names for anonymous modules, and does not add name keys to global.modules.
Enabled built-in modules can be returned by their explicit names; disabled built-ins remain unavailable.
zh-CN: 按显式 @module 名称返回当前脚本域中已加载的模块；没有匹配的显式命名模块时返回 null。
该入口只执行名称查询：不会导入源码、不会为匿名模块推导名称，也不会向 global.modules 添加名称键。
已启用的内置模块可按显式名称返回；未启用的内置模块仍不可用。

en: Loaded module registry exposed by the runtime global object. Current entries are keyed by normalized absolute or virtual source FullPath, not by @module name or resolver-relative ModulePath.
zh-CN: 运行时全局对象暴露的已加载模块注册表。当前条目以规范化的绝对或虚拟源码 FullPath 为键，而不是 @module 名称或解析器相对 ModulePath。
